note: UTC midnight is not the session-local calendar midnight in Kolkata.
original: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE DATE(delivered_at)=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at >= ((('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND delivered_at < (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: Inclusive upper bound includes the next midnight.
original: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE DATE(delivered_at)=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at >= (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) AND delivered_at <= ('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: A degenerate interval includes only midnight.
original: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE DATE(delivered_at)=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at BETWEEN (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) AND (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: Multiple matching children duplicate a customer.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.status IN ('placed','packing')) ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND o.status IN ('placed','packing') ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: Positive join reverses NOT EXISTS semantics.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.status IN ('placed','packing')) ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND o.status IN ('placed','packing') ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: Membership rewrite drops the delivered filter.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status='delivered') ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: City is not unique; removing DISTINCT changes multiplicities.
original: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ORDER BY city
rewrite: SELECT city FROM customers ORDER BY city

note: Top-level ORDER BY with LIMIT determines which rows are returned.
original: SELECT order_id FROM orders ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
rewrite: SELECT order_id FROM orders LIMIT 20

note: Unconstrained join filters customer ids with no matching store.
original: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c JOIN stores s ON s.store_id=c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: Dropping a status filter is not a redundant removal.
original: SELECT store_id,sum(total) AS payout FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id,store_id,total FROM orders WHERE status='delivered' AND delivered_at >= '2026-10-17T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz AND delivered_at < '2026-10-24T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz ORDER BY order_id) t GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,sum(total) AS payout FROM orders WHERE delivered_at >= '2026-10-17T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz AND delivered_at < '2026-10-24T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: Half-open bounds use session-local dates; handles every configured timezone.
original: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE DATE(delivered_at)=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at >= (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) AND delivered_at < ('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: CAST to date has the same local-calendar range.
original: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at::date=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at >= (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) AND delivered_at < ('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: date_trunc day on timestamptz uses the session timezone.
original: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE date_trunc('day',created_at)=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 ORDER BY order_id
rewrite: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE created_at >= (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) AND created_at < ('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date ORDER BY order_id

note: PostgreSQL timestamps have microsecond resolution; inclusive final microsecond is equivalent.
original: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE DATE(delivered_at)=('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,count(*) AS delivered,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE delivered_at BETWEEN (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date-1) AND (('2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz)::date::timestamptz - interval '1 microsecond') GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: DISTINCT preserves EXISTS membership multiplicity.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.status IN ('placed','packing')) ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND o.status IN ('placed','packing') ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: GROUP BY all outputs preserves membership multiplicity.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.status IN ('placed','packing')) ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.city='Bengaluru' AND o.status IN ('placed','packing') GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: IN set semantics are preserved by DISTINCT and the inner filter.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status='delivered') ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id,c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status='delivered' ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: Grouped left join and coalesce preserve scalar count for parents without children. Outer customers are bounded to three IDs so the deliberately unindexed scalar baseline is runnable.
original: SELECT c.customer_id,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id) AS n FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id<=3 ORDER BY c.customer_id
rewrite: SELECT c.customer_id,coalesce(o.n,0) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id,count(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id<=3 ORDER BY c.customer_id

note: PK order_id makes inner DISTINCT redundant; inner sort has no LIMIT.
original: SELECT store_id,sum(total) AS payout FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id,store_id,total FROM orders WHERE status='delivered' AND delivered_at >= '2026-10-17T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz AND delivered_at < '2026-10-24T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz ORDER BY order_id) t GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
rewrite: SELECT store_id,sum(total) AS payout FROM orders WHERE status='delivered' AND delivered_at >= '2026-10-17T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz AND delivered_at < '2026-10-24T12:00:00+00:00'::timestamptz GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

note: Selected primary key makes rows unique.
original: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id,name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id
rewrite: SELECT customer_id,name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id

note: Inner ordering without a limiting/window consumer is redundant.
original: SELECT order_id,total FROM (SELECT order_id,total FROM orders ORDER BY total) x ORDER BY order_id
rewrite: SELECT order_id,total FROM orders ORDER BY order_id

note: NOT NULL FK to a primary key makes the inner join redundant.
original: SELECT p.product_id,p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=p.category_id ORDER BY p.product_id
rewrite: SELECT p.product_id,p.name FROM products p ORDER BY p.product_id
